The composition features a molten bronze pool at the center surrounded by eight rotating splines made of refractive glass-like tracery. Each spline orbits independently while its own internal structure continuously shifts, creating a prismatic effect that refracts vibrant rainbow hues across the rotating assembly. The entire scene rotates slowly to emphasize the continuous mechanical motion, with each element maintaining its own visual identity while contributing to an overall sense of complex, evolving machinery.
